decision: Goldspire Territories is a region/location layer, not a faction.
atlas_effect: The wiki and Run Mode location system surface it as the top-level region containing Emeris, Sablewood, Hush, Open Vale, the Relay network, and faraway Athervast.

decision: Athervast is the faraway grand capital of the Goldspire Territories, separate from Emeris and not on the one-shot path.
atlas_effect: Athervast is world context and elite-center texture only; player-facing text must not tie it to the Hush delivery, a missing Keystone, or a local ward failure.

decision: Emeris is the prosperous territory capital and one-shot start city at the edge of Sablewood.
atlas_effect: Emeris becomes a first-class location profile. The party starts here and travels from Emeris toward Hush; Emeris itself has no missing ward or empty socket.

decision: Emeris Capital Gate is Emeris's own city gate, not an Athervast archway.
atlas_effect: Player-safe text describes a busy ceremonial gate and forest threshold; it must not show an empty ward socket or claim Athervast ownership.
